description.text:
7 single-target Holy/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, En-Holy, En-Holy Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Crystal Mode to user
Crystal Mode: Holy Ability Boost, Dualcast Holy, Zero Hone Cost to Holy Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 6 single-target Holy/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, [PHY Damage +30% & 50% DEF/RES Pierce] for 2 turns to user; After using Crystal Force, grants [Cap Break Level 0/1/1 for 2 turns, Quick/Quick/Instant Cast 2 & Quick/Quick/Instant ATB 1] to user with at least 0/2/4 I members
